raw_text: FACT CHECK: The video being shared as 'Indian army crackdown in Srinagar today' is OLD. We performed reverse image search on key frames and found the EXACT same footage uploaded on YouTube in July 2016 during the Burhan Wani aftermath protests. The Maruti van visible at 0:12 is a pre-2015 model discontinued in Kashmir. EXIF data from original upload confirms July 2016. NO such incident occurred in Srinagar today — J&K Police confirmed normalcy. This is recycled footage being shared with false context.
